overview: Bilingual marketing site for Robi Care, a clinical AI platform, with a full English and French (France) experience and an EN / FR toggle in the header.
features: EN / FR language toggle in the header on every page
Complete French (France) translation of every page, navigation, forms and footer
Language choice remembered across pages and return visits
Clinical safety wording preserved with identical meaning and force
Prices, tier names and numbers identical in both languages
